Australian Hydrological Geospatial Fabric (Geofabric) PRODUCT SUITE Version 3.3
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 
 The Geofabric version 3.3 product suite comprises five products:

 - Geofabric Surface Network                  (SH_Network)
 - Geofabric Surface Cartography              (SH_Cartography)
 - Geofabric Surface Catchments               (SH_Catchments)
 - Geofabric Hydrology Reporting Catchments   (HR_Catchments)
 - Geofabric Hydrology Reporting Regions      (HR_Regions)
 - Geofabric Groundwater Cartography		  (GW_Cartography)

 Version 3 products are currently supported by a product Guide and product 
 overview relationships diagram. Further Version 3 documentation is under 
 development.

 Version 3 products have kept the same structure (schema) as V2 products, 
 with the exception of two additional features classes and additional feature 
 class atttribution. Therefore V2.x documentation can be utilised, taking into 
 consideration the use of higher resolution foundation input data in Version 3.
 Also within existing Version 2 documentation, references to V2.1, dates, scales,
 product identifiers, geographic extent, etc cannot be relied upon when viewed 
 for Version 3 purposes.

 Documentation is available at http://www.bom.gov.au/water/geofabric/documentation.shtml.
 
 Geofabric Sample Toolset
 The Geofabric Sample Toolset can be used with Version 3.x data, but a D8 raster 
 dataset is not currently supplied for each drainage division, which means 
 the Create Catchments tool cannot be utilised with the spilt (2) option.
 A D8 raster can be arranged on request. 
 A topology file for use in the toolset is also not currently provided, 
 but can be created by the user, utilising the Geofabric Sample Toolset.
 A National V3.2 Topology file is currently being created, but takes over a week to
 complete, so we strongly encourage users to only create smaller topology files for 
 your specific areas of interest.
 #Note Create Catchments with the split option is not supported by ESRI in ArcMap10.6.0

 The Latest Geofabric Sample Toolset can be downloaded from
 ftp://ftp.bom.gov.au/anon/home/geofabric/
 
 
 Geofabric Version 3x FTP Site
 -----------------------
 ftp://ftp.bom.gov.au/anon/home/geofabric

The ftp site contains the following files as listed on the site:

 - Geofabric_Metadata_GDB_V3_2.zip   	-6 htm product metadata records, and 6 product 
                                     	xml records which can be read using the 
                                 	ISO19139 stylesheet in ArcCatalog 10.3.1 and the 
                                 	ANZMetalite tool.

 - Geofabric_V2_FTP_README.txt       	-this README file explaining the ftp zip files 
                                 	and their contents.

 - Geofabric_V3_2_PRODUCT_README.txt 	-A README file explaining more detailed information 
                                 	about the products, including an issues log.

 - HR_Catchments_GDB_V3.3.zip        	-Hydrology Reporting Catchments ESRI File 
                                 	Geodatabase, ESRI layer file, xml and htm 
                                 	metadata records, preferred flow nodes table,
									technical overview pdf and README txt file which 
									includes an issues log.

 - HR_Regions_GDB_V3_3.zip           	-Hydrology Reporting Regions ESRI File 
                                 	Geodatabase, ESRI layer file, xml and htm 
                                 	metadata records, and README txt file which 
                                 	includes an issues log.

 - SH_Cartography_GDB_V3_3.zip       	-Surface Cartography ESRI File Geodatabase, 
                                 	2 ESRI layer files, xml and htm metadata records,
                                 	and README txt file which includes an issues log.

 - SH_Catchments_GDB_V3_3.zip        	-Surface Catchments ESRI File Geodatabase, 
                                 	ESRI layer file, xml and htm metadata records,
                                 	and README txt file which includes an issues log.

 - SH_Network_GDB_V3_3.zip           	-Surface Network ESRI File Geodatabase, ESRI 
                                 	layer file, xml and htm metadata records, and
                                 	README txt file which includes an issues log. 

 - GW_Cartography_GDB_V3_3.zip          -Groundwater cartography ESRI File Geodatabase,
                                 	ESRI layer file, xml and htm metadata records, and
                                 	README txt file which includes an issues log.  
 
 - version2 subdirectory	        -National V2.1.1 Geofabric product suite based on
									1:250.000 scale mapped features and the 9 second 
									DEM, comprising 6 products, including Groundwater
									Cartography. 



USER FEEDBACK
-------------
Your feedback is vital to assist us in maintaining a business case to support and enhance
Geofabric products. Also by letting us know how you are using, or want to use the Geofabric;
you will enable us to better serve user needs. 

We request completion of a short feedback form about Geofabric V3.x products. The feedback 
Word document can be found on this ftp site and within each zip file, and when complete can
be sent to the AHGF@bom.gov.au mailbox.

If you have any questions or feedback (including questions of a more technical 
nature) on V3.x products, please feel to contact us via the AHGF mailbox and 
we'll endeavour to responde to your query in a timely manner. 

More Generally if you have any ideas, issues or questions related to any 
Geofabric product and it's potential use, we'd be delighted to hear from you, 
again preferable through our email AHGF@bom.gov.au.
